description: Compile-time arithmetic expression MODE (ISO §2023:7.3.6.3 GR2) - a CONFIRMED BEHAVIOR VARIANT (INV-3; kb/Work PB1592). Annex E.2 item 6 makes the mode implementor-defined only at COBOL-2023 and records the prior rule ('The previous COBOL Standard required the use of an arithmetic mode that is no longer supported'); the one mode 2023 removed is Standard Arithmetic (E.2 item 21). So at 2002/2014 a compile-time arithmetic expression (CONSTANT AS, >>DEFINE, >>IF/>>EVALUATE) evaluates in standard arithmetic - the SDIDI decimal engine, 34 digits, NEAREST-AWAY-FROM-ZERO - and at 2023 in the documented System.Decimal mode (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-29). The edge is the runtime behaviour register's DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined, read by CompileTimeArithmetic.For; this row carries the per-edition OUTPUT witness. The source's constant 0.0000000000000000000000000015 / 2 * 10000000000000000000000000000 is 7.5E-28 exactly in the SDIDI (x1E28 = 7.5, GR3 -> 7) and a tie rounded to the even 8E-28 in System.Decimal (-> 8). The construct itself (a compile-time arithmetic expression) is a COBOL-2002 introduction with the constant entry and the >> directives, so COBOL-85 refuses the source with the constant entry's introduction gate (COBOL0900).
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.6.3 GR2; Annex E.2 items 6 and 21 (compile-time arithmetic implementor-defined from 2023; standard arithmetic before); VCR row 12
vcr: VCR row 12 / Annex E.2 item 6 (2014->2023: arithmetic mode implementor-defined) - behavior:compile-time-arithmetic-mode
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CTAV.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 K-T2 CONSTANT AS
      0.0000000000000000000000000015 / 2
      * 10000000000000000000000000000.
01 W-N PIC 999.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE K-T2 TO W-N.
    DISPLAY "T2=" W-N.
    STOP RUN.

variant.confirm: CONFIRMED 2026-09-26 (kb/Work PB1592): standard arithmetic (SDIDI) at 2002/2014 gives T2=007, the documented System.Decimal mode at 2023 gives T2=008 - derived from ISO §2023:8.8.1.5.2 + §2023:11.9.11.2 GR3 a) and DOC-A.1-29, then §2023:7.3.6.3 GR3.
